split_rule: lexicographic match IDs; first 4 train, next 2 validation, last 1 locked test; all periods stay together
test_access: locked: no download, ingestion or scoring before final frozen candidate

baseline.name: nearest_player_majority_v1
baseline.smoothing: separate GameSection periods; no BAR-ATH masks on external matches

selection_policy: compare additions on validation matches only; frozen scenarios/seeds; limited search budget recorded before runs; no BAR-ATH public labels or target D fraction
uncertainty: report each match and each scenario; use match-level uncertainty when enough matches exist; no frame-iid confidence intervals
smoke_policy: score clean training smoke match and its fixed degradation scenarios only; never claim independent held-out performance
label_policy: use raw BallStatus and BallPossession with strict enum validation; unknown remains X, never defaults to A or D; dead ball overrides owner; labels stored separately
transfer_limitations: DFL multi-camera tracking is cleaner than competition ATD
provider possession conventions require comparison; same field names do not prove identical targets
match split is not a team-disjoint or season-disjoint benchmark
synthetic scenarios are stress tests, not a validated simulator of BAR-ATH
